sloka: विनिहत्य च यक्षौघान् विक्षोभ्य च विगृह्य च ।त्वया कैलास शिखराद् विमानम् इदम् आहृतम् ॥६-७-६॥।।
transliteration: vinihatya ca yakṣaughān vikṣobhya ca vigṛhya ca ।tvayā kailāsa śikharād vimānam idam āhṛtam ॥6-7-6॥।।

translations.english: He who dwells on the peak of Mount Kailasa, surrounded by numerous yakshas, was, after great affliction was visited upon him, made to submit to you.
